xna-type.name: AudioCategory
xna-type.summary: Represents a particular category of sounds.

property.name: Name
property.summary: Specifies the friendly name of this category.

method.name: Equals
method.summary: Determines whether the specified AudioCategory is equal to this AudioCategory.

overload.summary: Determines whether the specified AudioCategory is equal to this AudioCategory.

parameters.parameter: AudioCategory to compare with this instance.

overload.returns: Type: Boolean true if the objects are equal; false otherwise.

overload.summary: Determines whether the specified Object is equal to this AudioCategory.

parameters.parameter: Object to compare with this instance.

overload.returns: Type: Boolean true if the objects are equal; false otherwise.

method.name: GetHashCode
method.summary: Gets the hash code for this instance.

overload.summary: Gets the hash code for this instance.

method.name: Pause
method.summary: Pauses all sounds associated with this category.

overload.summary: Pauses all sounds associated with this category.

method.name: Resume
method.summary: Resumes all paused sounds associated with this category.

overload.summary: Resumes all paused sounds associated with this category.

method.name: SetVolume
method.summary: Sets the volume of all sounds associated with this category.

overload.summary: Sets the volume of all sounds associated with this category.

parameters.parameter: Volume value, between 0 and 1, where 0 is minimum volume (muted), and 1 is maximum volume.

method.name: Stop
method.summary: Stops all sounds associated with this category.

overload.summary: Stops all sounds associated with this category.

parameters.parameter: Enumerated value specifying how the sounds should be stopped.

method.name: ToString
method.summary: Returns a String representation of this AudioCategory.

overload.summary: Returns a String representation of this AudioCategory.

Object to the right of the equality operator.
